sources.name: Operator affiliate accounts
sources.note: Referral URLs point to each venue's official domain with the operator's referral code; discount is what the user receives at registration.

binance.notes: Binance affiliate landing page (bsmk); user gets 20% fee discount, operator earns 40% rebate from the Binance Affiliate program.

okx.notes: User gets 20% fee discount via referral, operator earns 40% rebate from the OKX Affiliate program.

bitget.notes: Bitget affiliate link (partner.bitget.cafe); confirm the exact rebate rate in the Bitget affiliate dashboard. User discount set to the standard 20%.

gate.notes: User gets 20% fee discount via referral, operator earns 40% rebate from the Gate.io Partner program.
